content: phx.gen.auth (Phoenix 1.8) generates an Accounts context (User, UserToken schemas) defaulting to magic-link-only auth (email verified implicitly on first magic-link use); generates accounts/scope.ex and wires config.exs so later phx.gen.* generators auto-inject scope-based authorization. All access tokens are revoked on first confirmation for security. This context is additive — it doesn't require restructuring Catalog/Search contexts, but Favorites (Phase 2) and admin/rental features (Phase 4) should take a Scope param and use the generated scope pattern for authorization rather than inventing a separate auth check.
